summary: Tested Additional boat details dialog, MMSI/children wording in Mayday/Pan-Pan (frontend + ship_log._label), backend BoatDetails validators, and the Invite crew Clear/Keep prompt, all on mobile 390x844. Backend: 34/34 pytest pass (new test_boat_additional_details.py + existing test_boat_type_pob_templates.py). Frontend: all requested flows work. There is one minor UX regression (bar does not collapse after the dialog closes) and two small polish items.

minor.issue: children is not clamped to pob-1 on the server (children=7 with pob=3 is stored as 7). Wording code clamps to pob when rendering, so output is fine. The stored data is just inconsistent.

ui_bugs.issue: After Done or Esc, document.activeElement is BODY, because Radix cannot return focus to a trigger since none is used. The section's onBlur therefore never fires, so the complete bar stays expanded even when the user focuses other controls (e.g. list-selector). Before, it collapsed when focus left. Suggested fix: in onClose, refocus the additional-details-btn via a ref, or setOpen(false) if complete. Also reset focused.current.

issues: The manual item 'or MMSI Number (Optional, skipper to delete or add one)' still shows right after the Pan-Pan vessel line, which now includes the MMSI automatically. This repeats the MMSI when one is set. Consider hiding or removing it when a 9-digit MMSI exists.
The summary shows a partial MMSI (e.g. 'MMSI 5123') while Mayday leaves it out. Consider showing it only when it has 9 digits, or flagging it.

action_items: Fix the Boat Details bar not collapsing after the Additional details dialog closes (focus is lost to BODY)
Optional: hide the redundant 'or MMSI Number' manual item when a 9-digit MMSI is set
Optional: clamp children to pob-1 in the backend validator (model_validator)
critical_code_review_comments: BoatDetails.jsx: AdditionalDetailsDialog is used without a DialogTrigger, so focus is not restored on close. That breaks the focus/blur collapse logic.
IntField: typing a value over max (children=5 when max is 3) is silently ignored and stays on screen until blur. Acceptable, but no hint is shown.
The email-log endpoint ctx passes children and a 9-digit-only MMSI correctly. ship_log._label was verified with unit tests. The real email send was NOT tested end to end, to avoid sending email.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Pro boat 'main' was restored to boat_type 'Gaff Cutter TEST', pob 3, children 0, mmsi '', units m, dims '', trip_days 0. Test invites test_invite_a/b/d@example.com were deleted. The TEST_bt_extra boat is deleted by the fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: the bar no longer has boat-type or POB inputs. The dialog's split, clamping (POB 4->2 clamps children to 1), MMSI digits-only with warning, units toggle suffixes, comma decimals, trip days, and Done/Esc close all work. Values persist after reload and in GET /api/me/boat. Focus is kept while slow-typing MMSI and the Other type input. Mayday and Pan-Pan wording was checked for 4/2, 2/1 (singular), 3/2, 3/0 and short MMSI (left out). Invite Clear/Keep was tested for the message, link (clipboard checked) and QR modes. The email mode was not clicked, to avoid a real send. Reopening the dialog starts clean. No horizontal overflow at 390px. test_boat_type_pob_templates.py is API-only and needed no update.
